# cschf

> Compute the [hyperbolic cosecant][hyperbolic-functions] of a single-precision floating-point number.

<section class="intro">

The [hyperbolic cosecant][hyperbolic-functions] is defined as

<!-- <equation class="equation" label="eq:hyperbolic_cosecant" align="center" raw="\operatorname{csch}(x) = \frac{1}{\sinh(x)} = \frac{2}{e^x - e^{-x}}" alt="Hyperbolic cosecant"> -->

```math
\mathop{\mathrm{csch}}(x) = \frac{1}{\sinh(x)} = \frac{2}{e^x - e^{-x}}
```

<!-- </equation> -->

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var cschf = require( '@stdlib/math/base/special/cschf' );
```

#### cschf( x )

Computes the [hyperbolic cosecant][hyperbolic-functions] of a single-precision floating-point number.

```javascript
var v = cschf( 0.0 );
// returns Infinity

v = cschf( 2.0 );
// returns ~0.2757

v = cschf( -2.0 );
// returns ~-0.2757

v = cschf( NaN );
// returns NaN
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var uniform = require( '@stdlib/random/array/uniform' );
var logEachMap = require( '@stdlib/console/log-each-map' );
var cschf = require( '@stdlib/math/base/special/cschf' );

var opts = {
    'dtype': 'float32'
};
var x = uniform( 100, -5.0, 5.0, opts );

logEachMap( 'cschf(%0.4f) = %0.4f', x, cschf );
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->

<!-- C usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

### Usage

```c
#include "stdlib/math/base/special/cschf.h"
```

#### stdlib_base_cschf( x )

Computes the [hyperbolic cosecant][hyperbolic-functions] of a single-precision floating-point number.

```c
float out = stdlib_base_cschf( 2.0f );
// returns ~0.2757f

out = stdlib_base_cschf( -2.0f );
// returns ~-0.2757f
```

The function accepts the following arguments:

-   **x**: `[in] float` input value.

```c
float stdlib_base_cschf( const float x );
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<!-- C API usage notes. Make sure to keep an empty line after the `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="notes">

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<!-- C API usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

### Examples

```c
#include "stdlib/math/base/special/cschf.h"
#include <stdio.h>

int main( void ) {
    const float x[] = { -5.0f, -3.89f, -2.78f, -1.67f, -0.56f, 0.56f, 1.67f, 2.78f, 3.89f, 5.0f };

    float v;
    int i;
    for ( i = 0; i < 10; i++ ) {
        v = stdlib_base_cschf( x[ i ] );
        printf( "cschf(%f) = %f\n", x[ i ], v );
    }
}
```

</section>
